tranches.acceptance_authority: Bounded effective configuration, explicit source precedence, blank-value preservation, and scrubbed libpq authority.
tranches.rationale: Defines one bounded effective configuration and database tuple before CLI, migration, restore, process, and release identities depend on it.

tranches.acceptance_authority: no out-of-repo write/rotation; all credential-bearing keys and value shapes redacted before persistence
